messages:
Maria Chen: opened a short PR to update the Ardent3B model card with supported configs and an SDK v2 migration snippet — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872 :eyes:
Maria Chen: added a throughput table (cpu/gpu) and a note about sequence-limit behavior with kv-cache. please skim, tagging @Josh for limits wording and @Selena for quant/compat wording
Josh Patel: looking now. small nit: the 'max_tokens' phrasing is a bit ambiguous — suggest 'max_input_tokens' + 'max_generated_tokens' to avoid confusion in examples
Liam O'Neill: saw one failing sample in the SDK v2 snippet — the streaming example uses old `client.stream()` API. should be `client.responses.stream()` in v2. here's a quick fix:
```
# old (incorrect)
for chunk in client.stream(resp):
  print(chunk.text)

# new (SDK v2)
for event in client.responses.stream(resp):
  if event.type == "response.delta":
    print(event.delta)
```
Selena Rivera: also, we need a short compatibility note for 4-bit quantized variants: Ardent3B-4q uses grouped-quant and requires runtime flag `--quant-grp=8` on Dedicated. can we add a one-liner in the compat section?
docs-bot: lint report for PR #4872: 6 style comments, 1 broken link detected (model-card/ardent3b/benchmarks -> 404)
Maria Chen: thanks — I'll patch the streaming snippet and change the token wording. Liam, can you drop the exact `responses.stream` snippet into the PR?
Liam O'Neill: done, pushed a commit with the corrected snippet and an inline comment about the event types. also updated the example output to reflect chunked deltas
Josh Patel: reworded the limits table header and added a short note about tail latency for long prefixes (measured on p4d: median 45ms/token, p95 110ms/token at 1024 seq). left one question about the bench link (was that supposed to point to a benchmark CSV?)
Maria Chen: yes, bench link should go to s3://bench-results/ardent3b/2026-03. docs-bot flagged an http link; I'll make it an s3 link and add a redirect note in the catalog index
Selena Rivera: added compat note for 4q and a sentence about model fallback: if quantized variant isn't available, runtime will fall back to `ardent3b-fp16` automatically (unless `strict_compat=true`). please review wording
Josh Patel: :thumbsup: wording looks good. one last ask — can we include the small SDK snippet for embeddings migration too? someone reported customers hitting embed shape changes when switching from v1->v2
Maria Chen: added an embeddings snippet and a quick migration checklist to the PR description. also fixed the broken link.
Liam O'Neill: all green on my end, ran the snippet locally.
docs-bot: PR #4872 updated: all checks passed (lint, linkcheck, examples smoke).
Maria Chen: great — merging in 5 if no objections. thanks everyone for quick reviews :rocket:
Josh Patel: no objections, go ahead
Selena Rivera: go ahead :+1:
Maria Chen: merged and tagged release-notes/ardent3b-compat
